agentSummary: Adds tools for Procedural Vegetation Editor assets in UE 5.8+: inner PCG graph authoring, export-node settings, generation jobs and the editor export command.
enablesAgentTo: Open ProceduralVegetation assets and edit their embedded PCG graph
List, add and configure Export nodes with validated FPVExportParams
Generate vegetation graphs as the PV editor does and inspect the mesh data reaching each Export node
Dispatch the editor's Export command from an interactive session
whenToEnable: Your UE 5.8+ project uses the experimental Procedural Vegetation Editor plugin (requires the PCG integration).
